limitations: Limited to the labelled 27-vertex ternary three-cube; historical priority may be affected by unindexed finite computations; no formula for general Hamming graphs.
scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive graph enumeration with two independently encoded programs; shortest-path assertions are generated from complete state and transition lists. No external independent audit.
title: Optimal connected domination in the ternary Hamming three-cube: one connected jump graph, 504 slide islands
